scope: Minimum recurring cash for a legally and physically operable leased productive site; private dwelling and household expenses excluded.

sources.title: Residential Tenancies Act, 2006
sources.finding: Land lease community sites are rental units/residential complexes and landlord maintenance duties apply.

sources.title: O. Reg. 517/06 Maintenance Standards
sources.finding: Potable water/fire-fighting water, passable roads, sewage security and landlord-supplied electrical safety are addressed in Part V.

sources.title: Build or buy a tiny home: rural servicing
sources.finding: Rural on-site wells and sewage systems, including septic or composting toilets, may be possible subject to local approval and the Building Code.

sources.title: Property Standards By-law 1999-030
sources.finding: Minimum property standards include yards, garbage storage, safe access and residential servicing; the consolidated copy is informational and site interpretation is required.

sources.title: Planning Act applications and site plan control
sources.finding: Multiple residential development over four units is subject to site-plan review in Owen Sound; pre-consultation identifies project-specific requirements.

legal_sources.notes: The scenario is a cash floor candidate, not legal advice. It includes unavoidable land debt/tax and explicitly financed access capital, but excludes discretionary management, vacancy, insurance without a lender requirement, paid maintenance and full lifecycle reserves. Distributed water, sewage, electric and site approvals remain required feasibility checks outside the shared fee.

affordability_comparison.limitation: No Owen Sound household income, rent distribution or existing ARC affordability bands were found in the repository; this is not a household affordability assessment.

scenario.label: Legal minimum / resident-maintained
scenario.description: Lowest-cost cash floor candidate: financed basic access capital only. Required water, sewage, electricity and waste arrangements are distributed or resident-maintained and remain site-specific rather than becoming an assumed centralized fee.

internal_access.label: Basic gravel access / internal road
internal_access.source_status: working planning assumption; municipal/fire access design and existing-road reuse must be confirmed
internal_access.legal_basis: O. Reg. 517/06 s. 32 requires roads in a land lease community to remain passable, clear and dust-controlled.
internal_access.notes: Capital is included only as an explicit financed access placeholder. If an existing compliant access serves the site, set capital to zero; if a new engineered road is required, replace with the approved quote.

shared_water.label: Potable/fire water arrangement
shared_water.source_status: legal requirement; servicing method and cost unresolved/site-specific
shared_water.legal_basis: O. Reg. 517/06 s. 31; system may be distributed if approved and adequate.
shared_water.notes: No centralized water capital or recurring shared fee is assumed. Each dwelling/site still needs an approved potable and fire-water solution.

shared_sewage.label: Sewage disposal arrangement
shared_sewage.source_status: legal requirement; servicing method and cost unresolved/site-specific
shared_sewage.legal_basis: O. Reg. 517/06 s. 35 and Building Code sewage requirements.
shared_sewage.notes: No centralized sewage capital or recurring shared fee is assumed. Approved septic, holding-tank or other lawful systems remain necessary.

electrical_distribution.label: Dwelling electrical supply
electrical_distribution.source_status: dwelling/site requirement; not a centralized ARC fee
electrical_distribution.legal_basis: O. Reg. 517/06 s. 36 applies where electricity is supplied by the landlord; Building Code/ESA requirements remain applicable to dwellings.
electrical_distribution.notes: Individual utility/grid or off-grid systems are outside this shared-infrastructure charge.

road_maintenance.label: Road maintenance materials
road_maintenance.source_status: legal duty; cash method not mandated
road_maintenance.notes: Resident labour is shown separately; contractor cash is zero in this baseline.

snow_clearing.label: Snow and obstruction clearing
snow_clearing.source_status: legal duty; cash method not mandated
snow_clearing.legal_basis: O. Reg. 517/06 s. 32 and applicable local property standards
snow_clearing.notes: Resident/community clearing is the modeled minimum method, subject to municipal/fire feasibility.

waste_system.label: Sanitary waste storage/handling
waste_system.legal_basis: O. Reg. 517/06 general maintenance and Owen Sound Property Standards By-law
waste_system.notes: No centralized waste contract or capital is assumed.

insurance.label: Infrastructure insurance
insurance.legal_basis: No general statutory minimum identified in this audit; lender/entity requirements remain possible.
insurance.notes: Zero in legal minimum unless a financing contract or site approval requires a policy.

administration.label: Infrastructure administration
administration.source_status: Excluded; open-source/resident governance is modeled in the land layer.

common_water_or_building.notes: No common building, laundry or shared equipment.

common_property_operations.description: No contractor budget. Residents maintain only common-property drainage and minimum grounds/hazard standards here. Internal-road passability, snow/obstruction control and sanitary waste handling are represented in the separate infrastructure layer so the same work is not counted twice.
